Vehicle inspected at the shop following a collision during a left turn. The front bumper cover is cracked across the
center, the left headlamp assembly is broken, and the hood shows a crease with paint loss along the leading edge.
The left fender has a dented radiator support area that will need partial replacement and alignment. Damage pattern
is largely consistent with the reported impact direction. No prior damage to this vehicle is known to us. The repair plan
covers replacing the bumper cover and headlamp, straightening the hood, and refinishing affected panels. Labor
hours submitted fit the scope of the damage, and the invoices show no repeated charges for the same work.
